text: What if a pill could make you smarter, more alert, and more successful in one fell swoop—would you take it? In this episode of the Dutch podcast series from the UvA "Net Echt", neuroscientist Simon van Gaal and philosopher of neuroscience Jolien Francken delve into the world of brain enhancement: from Ritalin to neuro-gadgets and the persistent myth that we use only 20 percent of our brains. What does a brain scan really tell us, when are you still ‘yourself’ if you tinker with your brain, and how far are we willing to go in the pursuit of a better mind?
title: Simon talks about brain improvement
